place.source_title: 15-27 North Main Street (Commercial Buildings), 23 North Main Street

brief: Narrow three-storey Queen Anne commercial front of dark brick with bands of patterned brick, round-arched windows on the top floor and a corbelled parapet; one of the few buildings to survive the 1875 fire, remodelled 1884-85 as a saloon and hall. The ground floor is a gutted shopfront with a recessed door between neighbours selling paint and wallpaper.

facade.notes: 23 N Main St (Oshkosh WI, c.1885), HABS: a narrow three-storey dark-brick Queen Anne front with patterned-brick bands, round-arched top windows and a corbelled parapet, an empty boarded shopfront with peeling signboard; neighbours: a Gothic-corbelled paint and wallpaper store ('We're open, business as usual') and a 'Good Knights' bar -- the block before clearance

why.note: HABS recorded these Main Street buildings before urban-renewal or highway demolition (1970s-80s)
